name: Fight Till Death — All Units Engage Gorgon-Prime

cycle_advancement.world_state: The Sump Charnel Meatgrinder — Phase 1 Cracked

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The Sump Charnel Ditches have become a charnel meatgrinder. The Matriarch's dorsal carapace is blown apart, exposing churning viscera as autocannon tracers and burning lasfire tear into its flanks.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Bio-Titanic Matriarch Eruption
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: The Sump Gorgon-Matriarch has sustained 190 damage and its primary armor plates are shattered, but it is thrashing violently in lethal death agony.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Weather the enraged counter-barrage or deliver the fatal coup de grâce before the remaining frontline defenders bleed out.

active_combat_encounters.current_phase: Phase 2: Exposed Bio-Core & Enraged Acid Thrash
active_combat_encounters.armor_status: Carapace Smashed & Torn Open (Small arms / Shotgun now deal full damage to exposed thorax)
active_combat_encounters.tactical_requirements: The adamantine carapace is cracked! Concentrated fire on the exposed glowing bio-core can now kill it, but the beast is in a berserk death-thrash venting uncontrolled caustic gouts.
active_combat_encounters.failure_consequences: Lethal wipe of all frontline forces in the Charnel Ditches if not finished off immediately.

sub_units.armament: Kantrael Lasguns, combat knives, scarred flak vests
sub_units.morale: Fanatical Martyrdom (80% — Inspired by Supreme Order)
sub_units.station: Charnel Trench rim (8 conscripts crushed/melted in the charge)

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: CRITICAL COMBAT ALERT: Phase 1 armor cracked! Matriarch Prime in berserk thrash. All fire directed at exposed core.

new_decision.decision: Bellowed 'STAND FAST AND DIE FOR THE EMPEROR!' while charging point-blank through caustic bile to plant a Mark IV Krak Grenade directly into the Matriarch's thoracic breach.
new_decision.impact: Detonated krak charge on target, blowing a massive crater into the dorsal carapace; took severe acid splash and kinetic recoil (Vitality 85 -> 70).

new_decision.decision: Roared 'FOR DA SARGE!' and charged the titan, locking his humming Power Fist into the primary scythe-arm joint and violently ripping off an entire 8-foot talon plate before being hurled against ferrocrete.
new_decision.impact: Critically fractured the beast's armor; Bragg suffered massive trauma, broken ribs, and acid burns (Vitality 70 -> 40), clinging to life.

new_decision.decision: Crawled out from beneath the collapsed iron girders with blood running down his face, dragging a severed battery pack to fire continuous las-bursts into the beast's sensory cluster.
new_decision.impact: Temporarily blinded the beast's forward ocular lobes, allowing Vane to close the distance; Jax took shrapnel from wild flailing (Vitality 40 -> 30).
